 Follow Jimmy Kimmel Corners Martin Short on Meryl Streep Dating Rumors
 The Daily Beast Updated Fri, November 20, 2026 at 4:58 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Martin Short has found himself in the hot seat over his rumored romance with Meryl Streep.Short, 76, appeared on Jimmy Kimmel Live with his Only Murders in the Building co-star, Selena Gomez, who kicked off the teasing about his close relationship with Streep. The pair told Kimmel about the guest stars they were most excited to work with for the show's upcoming sixth season when Short mentioned Streep, 77. "I don't know why she keeps coming back," Gomez said slyly, darting her eyes at Short.
